observations.title: SignInActivityId formats
observations.text: SignInActivityId can contain padded token identifiers and GUID-shaped values. Remove trailing Base64 padding when correlating token identifiers and preserve case. Padding removal does not convert GUID-shaped values into token identifiers. Inspect unmatched GUID-shaped values separately.
observations.guidance: Compare nonempty token identifiers with exact equality after removing only trailing Base64 padding. Keep tenant, actor, application, and time context.
observations.query:
AADGraphActivityLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize by SignInActivityId
| summarize
    Padded=countif(SignInActivityId endswith "=="),
    GUID=countif(SignInActivityId matches regex @"^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$"),
    TotalUnique=dcount(SignInActivityId)
